title: Taiwan Banks Turn to AI as Cyberattacks Double
summaryZh: 網攻倍增，台灣銀行加強運用AI防禦。
summaryHi: साइबर हमले दोगुने होने पर ताइवान के बैंक बचाव के लिए AI का सहारा ले रहे हैं।
summaryEs: Los bancos de Taiwán recurren a la IA ante el doble de ciberataques.
summaryJa: サイバー攻撃が倍増、台湾の銀行がAIで防御強化。
summaryKo: 사이버 공격 두 배 증가, 대만 은행들 AI로 방어 강화.
summaryEn: Taiwan Cooperative Bank says attacks doubled this year, and First Bank blocked 2.2 million, so banks are using AI to spot and stop threats.
paragraphs: Taiwan's banks are increasingly relying on artificial intelligence to spot suspicious activity, uncover weaknesses in their systems and fend off cyberattacks, as threats against the financial sector intensify.

Taiwan Cooperative Bank reported a sharp rise in suspicious external probes and attacks during the first ten months of 2026, with the monthly average roughly twice that of 2025. About 80 percent of the attack volume was concentrated between August and October.

The attacks mainly targeted internet-facing services such as bank websites, online banking and corporate banking platforms. First Bank said its web application firewall blocked around 2.2 million attacks from January to October, noting that probing activity climbed significantly from the third quarter.

In response, First Bank has introduced AI-powered network and endpoint detection, Bank of Taiwan relies on AI-assisted threat detection, and Taiwan Cooperative Bank is trialling AI-based security tools. None of the banks has identified an attack that can be definitively attributed to autonomous AI, although they admit that increasingly automated methods make this harder to judge.

Chen Chia-hung, a consultant at Rays Technology, urged banks to go beyond tools that only detect attacks after the fact. Instead, he said, they should use AI to simulate attacks and probe their own defences, and include AI-driven attacks in routine cybersecurity drills.
Banks in Taiwan are using AI to stop computer attacks. AI is a smart computer program. It can find danger fast.
There are more attacks this year. At Taiwan Cooperative Bank, the number of attacks each month is about two times last year's number. Most of the attacks came between August and October.
The attackers try to get into bank websites and online banking. First Bank stopped about 2.2 million attacks from January to October.
Now banks use AI to watch their computers. It looks for strange activity and finds weak places in the system. Bank of Taiwan also uses AI. Taiwan Cooperative Bank is testing new AI tools.
An expert says banks should also use AI to make fake attacks. Then they can test their safety before real attackers come.

paragraphs: Banks in Taiwan are turning to artificial intelligence (AI) to protect themselves from cyberattacks, as online threats to the financial sector keep growing.

Taiwan Cooperative Bank said it saw more suspicious probes and attacks in the first ten months of 2026. The monthly average was about double last year's. Around 80 percent of the attacks happened between August and October.

Most attacks targeted services that customers use on the internet, such as bank websites, online banking and corporate banking. First Bank said its firewall blocked about 2.2 million attacks between January and October, with a big rise from the third quarter.

To fight back, First Bank uses AI to watch its network and computers, Bank of Taiwan uses AI to help detect threats, and Taiwan Cooperative Bank is testing AI security tools. The banks say they have not found an attack clearly carried out by AI on its own, but it is getting harder to tell.

A cybersecurity consultant, Chen Chia-hung, said banks should not only react after an attack. He suggested using AI to copy attacks and test defences, and adding AI attacks to regular security drills.
sentZh: 隨著金融業面臨的網路威脅持續增加，台灣的銀行正轉而運用人工智慧（AI）來保護自己免受網路攻擊。
合作金庫銀行表示，2026年前十個月出現了更多可疑的探測和攻擊。
每月平均次數約為去年的兩倍。
大約八成的攻擊發生在八月到十月之間。
大多數攻擊針對顧客在網路上使用的服務，例如銀行網站、網路銀行和企業網銀。
第一銀行表示，它的防火牆在一月到十月間擋下約220萬次攻擊，且從第三季起大幅增加。
為了反擊，第一銀行用AI監看網路和電腦，臺灣銀行用AI協助偵測威脅，合作金庫銀行則在測試AI資安工具。
這些銀行說，它們尚未發現明確由AI自行發動的攻擊，但這越來越難分辨。
資安顧問陳嘉宏表示，銀行不應只在遭到攻擊後才反應。
他建議用AI模擬攻擊來測試防禦，並把AI攻擊加入定期的資安演練。

Taiwan Cooperative Bank reported a sharp rise in suspicious external probes and attacks during the first ten months of 2026, with the monthly average roughly twice that of 2025. About 80 percent of the attack volume was concentrated between August and October.

The attacks mainly targeted internet-facing services such as bank websites, online banking and corporate banking platforms. In response, First Bank has introduced AI-powered network and endpoint detection, Bank of Taiwan relies on AI-assisted threat detection, and Taiwan Cooperative Bank is trialling AI-based security tools. Chen Chia-hung, a consultant at Rays Technology, urged banks to go beyond tools that only detect attacks after the fact. Instead, he said, they should use AI to simulate attacks and probe their own defences, and include AI-driven attacks in routine cybersecurity drills.
sentZh: 隨著針對金融業的威脅加劇，台灣的銀行越來越依賴人工智慧來察覺可疑活動、找出系統弱點並抵擋網路攻擊。
合作金庫銀行通報，2026年前十個月可疑的外部探測與攻擊急劇增加，每月平均約為2025年的兩倍。
約八成的攻擊量集中在八月到十月之間。
這些攻擊主要針對面向網際網路的服務，例如銀行網站、網路銀行和企業網銀平台。
第一銀行表示，其網頁應用程式防火牆在一月至十月間擋下約220萬次攻擊，並指出探測活動從第三季起顯著攀升。
為此，第一銀行導入了AI驅動的網路與端點偵測，臺灣銀行仰賴AI輔助的威脅偵測，合作金庫銀行則在試用以AI為基礎的資安工具。
目前沒有任何一家銀行找到能明確歸咎於自主AI的攻擊，不過它們承認，越來越自動化的手法讓這點更難判斷。
瑞思科技顧問陳嘉宏呼籲銀行，不要只依賴事後才偵測攻擊的工具。
他說，銀行反而應該用AI模擬攻擊、探測自己的防禦，並把AI驅動的攻擊納入例行資安演練。

paragraphs: Confronted with a mounting wave of cyber threats, Taiwan's banks are turning to artificial intelligence to flag suspicious activity, expose vulnerabilities in their systems and repel intrusions before they cause damage.

The scale of the problem is striking. Taiwan Cooperative Bank recorded a marked increase in hostile external probes over the first ten months of 2026, with the monthly average running at roughly double the 2025 level. Some 80 percent of that volume was clustered in the three months from August to October.

Attackers have largely focused on internet-facing services, from public websites to online and corporate banking platforms. First Bank said its web application firewall repelled about 2.2 million attacks between January and October, with probing escalating noticeably from the third quarter onwards.

Lenders have responded by weaving AI into their defences. First Bank now runs AI-powered network and endpoint detection, Bank of Taiwan relies on AI-assisted threat detection, and Taiwan Cooperative Bank is piloting AI-based security tools. Tellingly, none has yet pinned an attack definitively on autonomous AI, conceding that increasingly automated techniques blur the line between human and machine attackers.

Consultant Chen Chia-hung of Rays Technology argues that reactive tools are no longer enough. Banks, he contends, should harness AI to simulate attacks and stress-test their own systems, and should build AI-driven scenarios into their routine cybersecurity drills.
sentZh: 面對日益升高的網路威脅浪潮，台灣的銀行正轉向人工智慧，在入侵造成損害之前標記可疑活動、揭露系統漏洞並擊退入侵。
問題的規模相當驚人。
合作金庫銀行記錄到，2026年前十個月帶有敵意的外部探測明顯增加，每月平均約為2025年水準的兩倍。
其中約八成集中在八月至十月這三個月。
攻擊者大多鎖定面向網際網路的服務，從公開網站到網路銀行與企業網銀平台都有。
第一銀行表示，其網頁應用程式防火牆在一月至十月間擊退約220萬次攻擊，探測行為從第三季起明顯升級。
銀行業的回應是把AI融入防禦體系。
第一銀行現在運行AI驅動的網路與端點偵測，臺灣銀行仰賴AI輔助的威脅偵測，合作金庫銀行則在試辦以AI為基礎的資安工具。
耐人尋味的是，至今沒有一家銀行能明確把攻擊歸咎於自主AI，並承認日益自動化的技術模糊了人類與機器攻擊者之間的界線。
瑞思科技顧問陳嘉宏認為，被動應對的工具已經不夠了。
他主張，銀行應該善用AI模擬攻擊、對自家系統進行壓力測試，並把AI驅動的情境納入例行資安演練。

paragraphs: Taiwan's banking sector is increasingly deploying artificial intelligence as a frontline defence, using it to identify anomalous activity, pinpoint systemic vulnerabilities and thwart cyberattacks at a time when threats to financial institutions are escalating.

The figures underline the severity of the challenge. Taiwan Cooperative Bank documented a substantial surge in suspicious external probes during the first ten months of 2026, with the monthly average approximately twice the 2025 figure. Notably, around 80 percent of the attack volume was concentrated between August and October.

These incursions predominantly targeted internet-facing services, including public websites and online and corporate banking platforms. First Bank reported that its web application firewall intercepted roughly 2.2 million attacks between January and October, observing that reconnaissance activity intensified considerably from the third quarter.

Consequently, lenders are integrating AI across their security architecture. First Bank operates AI-powered network and endpoint detection, Bank of Taiwan employs AI-assisted threat detection, and Taiwan Cooperative Bank is evaluating AI-based tools. Significantly, no bank has conclusively attributed an attack to autonomous AI, although all acknowledge that increasingly automated methods make such attribution problematic.

Chen Chia-hung, a consultant with Rays Technology, maintains that purely reactive detection is inadequate. He advocates using AI to simulate attacks and rigorously test defences, and incorporating AI-driven scenarios into routine cybersecurity drills.
sentZh: 台灣銀行業正越來越多地把人工智慧部署為第一線防禦，在金融機構面臨的威脅不斷升級之際，用它來辨識異常活動、精確找出系統性漏洞並阻止網路攻擊。
這些數據凸顯了挑戰的嚴重性。
合作金庫銀行記錄到，2026年前十個月可疑的外部探測大幅激增，每月平均約為2025年數字的兩倍。
值得注意的是，約八成的攻擊量集中在八月至十月之間。
這些入侵主要針對面向網際網路的服務，包括公開網站以及網路銀行和企業網銀平台。
第一銀行報告，其網頁應用程式防火牆在一月至十月間攔截了約220萬次攻擊，並觀察到偵察活動從第三季起大幅增強。
因此，銀行正在把AI整合到整個資安架構中。
第一銀行運作AI驅動的網路與端點偵測，臺灣銀行採用AI輔助的威脅偵測，合作金庫銀行則在評估以AI為基礎的工具。
值得一提的是，沒有任何銀行能確鑿地將攻擊歸因於自主AI，但各銀行都承認，越來越自動化的手法讓這種歸因變得困難。
瑞思科技顧問陳嘉宏堅持認為，純粹被動的偵測並不足夠。
他提倡用AI模擬攻擊、嚴格測試防禦，並把AI驅動的情境納入例行資安演練。

noteHi.usage: intercept a message/attack; be intercepted by।

noteEs.meaning: interceptar; detener algo antes de que llegue.
noteEs.usage: intercept a message/attack; be intercepted by.

noteJa.meaning: 途中で阻止する；傍受する。

noteKo.usage: intercept a message/attack, be intercepted by.

noteEn.meaning: stopped something before it reached its target.

internet.ex: I found the recipe on the internet.

month.ex: The rent is due each month.

noteEs.exampleTr: Los ingenieros por fin localizaron la causa del apagón.

noteJa.exampleTr: 技術者たちはついに停電の原因を突き止めた。

purely.ex: The decision was made purely on cost.

repel.ex: The castle walls helped repel invaders.

services.ex: Online services are now used by everyone.

example.zh: 官員仍在評估損害的嚴重程度。

noteEs.meaning: gravedad; lo serio que es algo.

noteKo.usage: the severity of ~, assess the severity 형태.

strange.ex: I got a strange message today.

substantial.ex: The town received a substantial grant.

suggested.ex: The teacher suggested a new reading plan.

noteEs.exampleTr: Hubo un aumento repentino de compras en línea antes de las fiestas.

noteKo.usage: a surge in ~; 동사 surge to/by.

noteEn.usage: Common: 'a surge in something', 'a sudden surge', 'surge in demand'.

systemic.ex: The report found systemic problems in the software.

note.meaning: 系統性的；影響整個體系的。

example.zh: 專家警告銀行業存在系統性風險。

noteJa.exampleTr: 専門家は銀行業界のシステミックリスクを警告した。

systems.en: sets of computers or programs working together

taiwan.en: an island country in East Asia

targeted.ex: Targeted help is needed for older workers.

technology.en: machines and methods based on science; part of a company name

tell.ex: It is hard to tell real emails from fake ones.

test.ex: Banks test their systems every month.

testing.ex: Labs are testing samples from the farm.

then.ex: Then the trains will be faster.

these.en: the ones here or just mentioned

noteJa.usage: thwart an attack/plan、be thwarted by の形。

noteKo.usage: thwart an attack/plan, be thwarted by 형태.

volume.ex: The volume of emails grows every year.

year.ex: The festival happens once a year.
